coordinates: Top-view native board coordinates, translated only; +x right, +y down
notes: Geometry is extracted from the saved KiCad PCB; it is not generated from the electrical simulation.
Component/pad positions include native rotation and back-side transforms. All coordinates remain top-view.
Footprint bounds exclude reference/value text. Body/Fab/silkscreen geometry is supplied separately.
Copper zone fills, text glyphs, solder mask openings and 3D models are omitted from this 2D export.
Custom/non-orthogonal pad polygons use KiCad's native effective polygon conversion.
